preconditions.description: T is the number of test cases, an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.description: For each test case, N is the number of segments, an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.description: For each test case, each Wi is an integer attractiveness value between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly one integer.
Each output line is a valid integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_line) >= max(int(w) for w in [int(w) for w in stdin.splitlines()[i+1].split()]) for i, stdout_line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output velocity is at least as large as the maximum attractiveness in the corresponding input.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_line) == min(V for V in range(max(int(w) for w in [int(w) for w in stdin.splitlines()[i+1].split()]), 10**6 + 1) if all(V >= int(w) for w in [int(w) for w in stdin.splitlines()[i+1].split()]) and all(V - k >= int(w) for k, w in enumerate([int(w) for w in stdin.splitlines()[i+1].split()])) for i, stdout_line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output velocity is the minimal possible initial velocity such that for each segment k (0-based), the velocity V - k is at least the attractiveness of the k-th segment.
